Adult contributions only. This issue is public. Do not include student names, work, records, private reports, credentials or confidential information. Opening a file in the Activity Studio does not submit it; this issue is a separate public proposal.

## What did you create or change?

Describe the learning goal, prerequisites and one useful change. A short explanation is enough. This is a draft for review, not a claim of classroom validation.

## What did you check?

Try every challenge. Describe any confusing instructions, access barriers or open questions. A solvable bridge and a completed animation do not establish learning. Do not recruit children or upload learner evidence here.

## Credit, rights and assistance

Confirm that you may share your contribution under CC BY 4.0, and preserve inherited attribution. Identify any additional sources and their limits. Disclose material AI assistance and explain what you checked. Use only a public name or pen name you want credited.

## Review

A maintainer will decide whether to accept, request changes or defer the draft, with reasons. Acceptance into this early collection does not itself mean qualified educational or accessibility review. No guaranteed response time or automatic publication.
